title: South China Sea Code of Conduct talks now 70 pct complete, 'certain elements' need to be refined—DFA exec
summary: The negotiations on the long-awaited Code of Conduct in the South China Sea are 70 percent completed, the Department of Foreign Affairs said Friday.
